title: 第7章 在秘境里当场突破第8章 正好带你去个好地方溜溜弯
slug: 满级师妹她缺德但能打
content_zh:
她一边走，一边精准地识别出各种低阶灵植（主要以食用价值判断），指挥着三个队员采集，自己则时不时蹲下研究一下土质或者奇怪的昆虫。
张远、李薇、王猛从一开始的紧张，慢慢变得麻木，最后也开始沉浸在“采集”
的快乐中，储物袋渐渐鼓胀起来，虽然…大部分好像都是食材。
突然！
“嘶嘶——”
前方的灌木丛剧烈晃动，一股腥风扑面而来！
紧接着，一条水桶粗细、浑身覆盖着漆黑鳞片、头生独角的巨蟒猛地窜出！
它双眼赤红，散发着暴戾的气息，实力赫然达到了炼气六层！
远超他们小队任何人！
“是黑水玄蛇！
小心！”
张远惊呼，脸色煞白，急忙祭出一面小盾。
李薇吓得尖叫一声，躲到后面。
王猛也握紧剑，手却在发抖。
炼气六层的妖兽，对于他们这支队伍来说，几乎是不可战胜的存在！
那黑水玄蛇显然被他们的气息惊动，赤红的蛇瞳锁定了最前面的云杳杳，张开血盆大口，带着毒液的獠牙狠狠噬咬而来！
速度快得惊人！
“师姐小心！”
三人齐声惊呼，心都提到了嗓子眼！
云杳杳却似乎愣了一下，看着那扑来的蛇口，非但没有后退，反而眼睛一亮：“哦？独角黑水蛇？这蛇胆是清目的好东西，蛇肉听说也挺劲道，炖汤或者椒盐应该都不错…”

三人：“？？？”
师姐！
现在是讨论吃的时候吗？！
眼看蛇口就要将云杳杳吞没！
就在这千钧一发之际，云杳杳动了！
她没有施展任何华丽的法术，也没有拔剑，只是脚下看似随意地一错步，身体以一个极其诡异刁钻的角度，险之又险地避开了蛇口的噬咬！
那动作轻盈得不像话，仿佛早就计算好了蛇的攻击轨迹一般！
同时，她右手快如闪电地伸出，并指如刀，指尖凝聚着一点高度压缩的、锐利无匹的灵力（蕴含着一丝她自己都没完全弄懂的奇特锋锐之气），精准无比地点在了黑水玄蛇下颌逆鳞下方三寸的一个极其隐蔽的弱点之上！
这一点，看似轻描淡写，却蕴含着恐怖的力量！
“噗嗤！”
一声轻微的闷响！
那来势汹汹的黑水玄蛇，庞大的身躯猛地一僵，赤红的瞳孔瞬间涣散，然后轰然倒地，抽搐了两下，便再无声息！
它的颅内已被那一点锐利之气彻底震碎！
秒杀！
炼气六层妖兽，被炼气四层巅峰一击秒杀！
整个过程发生在电光火石之间！
张远、李薇、王猛三人还保持着防御和惊恐的姿势，眼睛瞪得滚圆，嘴巴张得能塞进鸡蛋，彻底石化在原地。
发生了什么？！
师姐…师姐她…一招就把炼气六层的黑水玄蛇给…宰了？！
还是秒杀？！

云杳杳拍了拍手，蹲下身，打量着蛇尸，满意地点点头：“个头不小，够吃好几顿了。
蛇胆、蛇肉、蛇皮…都是好东西。
你们愣着干嘛？过来帮忙处理一下啊，记得蛇血别浪费，装起来以后做毛血旺。”
content_en:
As she walked, she accurately identified various low-level spiritual plants (mainly judged by their edible value), and directed the three team members to collect them. She would squat down from time to time to study the soil or strange insects.
Zhang Yuan, Li Wei, and Wang Meng were nervous at the beginning, but gradually became numb, and finally began to immerse themselves in "collection"
Amidst the happiness, the storage bag gradually bulged, although... most of it seemed to be food.
Sudden!
"Hiss——"
The bushes in front shook violently, and a fishy wind blew towards my face!
Immediately afterwards, a huge python as thick as a bucket, covered with pitch-black scales and with a single horn on its head, suddenly jumped out!
Its eyes were red, exuding a violent aura, and its strength had reached the sixth level of Qi Refining!
Far more than anyone else in their team!
“It’s the Black Water Black Snake!
Be careful! "
Zhang Yuan exclaimed, his face turned pale, and he hurriedly held out a small shield.
Li Wei screamed in fright and hid behind.
Wang Meng also tightened his grip on the sword, but his hands were trembling.
The monsters at the sixth level of Qi Refining are almost invincible to their team!
The black water black snake was obviously alarmed by their aura. Its red snake eyes locked on Yun Yaoyao at the front, opened its bloody mouth, and bit hard with its venomous fangs!
The speed is amazing!
"Sister, be careful!"
The three of them exclaimed in unison, their hearts in their throats!
Yun Yaoyao seemed to be stunned for a moment. Looking at the snake coming towards him, instead of retreating, his eyes lit up: "Oh? One-horned black water snake? This snake's gall is good for eyesight. I heard that the snake meat is quite strong. It should be good for stew or salt and pepper..."
Three people: "???"
Senior sister!
Is now the time to talk about eating? !
Seeing that the Shekou is about to swallow Yun Yaoyao!
At this critical moment, the clouds moved!
She didn't cast any gorgeous spells, nor did she draw her sword. She just made a seemingly random wrong step with her feet, and her body was at an extremely weird and tricky angle, narrowly avoiding the bite of the snake's mouth!
The movement was incredibly light, as if the snake's attack trajectory had been calculated long ago!
At the same time, she stretched out her right hand as fast as lightning and pointed it like a knife. The fingertips condensed a bit of highly compressed and sharp spiritual power (containing a trace of strange sharpness that she did not fully understand), and it was accurately positioned on an extremely hidden weakness three inches below the inverse scale of the lower jaw of the Black Water Black Snake!
This may seem like an understatement, but it contains terrifying power!
"Pfft!"
A slight muffled sound!
The menacing Black Water Black Snake's huge body suddenly stiffened, its red pupils instantly blurred, and then it fell to the ground, twitched twice, and then became silent again!
Its skull has been completely shattered by that sharp energy!
Instant kill!
A monster at the sixth level of Qi refining was instantly killed by a single blow from the peak of the fourth level of Qi refining!
The whole process happened in a blink of an eye!
Zhang Yuan, Li Wei, and Wang Meng still maintained defensive and frightened postures, their eyes widened, their mouths opened wide enough to stuff an egg, and they were completely petrified on the spot.
what happened? !
Senior Sister...Senior Sister, she...killed the Black Water Black Snake on the sixth level of Qi Refining with one move? !
Or a flash sale? !
Yun Yaoyao clapped his hands, squatted down, looked at the snake corpse, and nodded with satisfaction: "It's not small, enough to eat several meals.
Snake gallbladder, snake meat, snake skin... are all good things.
Why are you standing there? Come over here and help with the treatment. Remember not to waste the snake blood. Pack it up and make Maoxuewang later. "
